items.description: Methods, skeptic, pedagogy, evidence, style, and structure critics are dispatched and collected independently.
The chapter spine is ratified before a final review; otherwise every spine-dependent finding and verdict is explicitly provisional.
Style, structure, and figure detector results are available to the panel or their absence is explicitly reported.
Synthesis ranks fatal and major concerns before agreement count and surfaces critic disagreement.
No file write or ledger advance occurs until the user approves the proposed change.
The reviser inserts no citation absent from or unverified in references.bib.
The reviser adds no unsupported empirical claim; verified Croatian evidence follows the same rule as all other evidence.
